question: Does adding liquid MEXC tradfi perpetuals to the frozen DON8/EMA8/VOL8 trend portfolio raise independent breadth and net returns after costs and funding?
registration_note: Registered 2026-09-26, before any day at or after the start existed. The universe comes from a mechanical rule applied to MEXC contract metadata and 24h turnover on 2026-09-26; no strategy P&L on any tradfi instrument was computed before registration.

universe_rule.exclude: leveraged or inverse ETF proxies, single stocks, sector ETFs
universe_rule.one_contract_per_underlying: keep the higher 24h turnover (USOIL over UKOIL)

source.funding: contract/funding_rate/history, all settlements up to as_of

economics.portfolio: equal capital across all strategy x symbol sleeves in the group, rebalanced daily at 00:00 UTC; inter-sleeve rebalancing not charged

reporting.statistic: mean daily net return, Newey-West t (5 lags), annualized Sharpe (sqrt 365), funding contribution
reporting.breadth: participation ratio of the group's forward daily sleeve returns, reported once there are at least 60 days
reporting.before_review: descriptive only: no verdict, no promotion

known_risks: Tradfi perp funding is large and unstable (10-84%/yr absolute over 2025-2026); it is charged, not assumed away.
Tradfi perps track venue index prices that may move on weekends while the underlying market is closed.
20 bps round trip is assumed for all instruments; the liquidity floor exists so that assumption stays credible.
